Name: Stardew Messages - Tutorial Pack
Author: Jybee
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]Stardew Messages - Tutorial Pack[/b] is a narrative tutorial content pack for [b]Stardew Messages[/b].

It teaches you how to create in-game SMS/MMS content step by step through 8 playable lessons.
You will learn how to build conversations, edit i18n text, create choices and branches, add MMS images, use the Gallery, create custom contacts, hide and reveal senders, delete threads and contacts, use triggers, control delivery flow, and chain conversations together.This is both a playable tutorial and a practical example pack for content creators.[/size]

[size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b]Stardew Messages - Core Framework 1.0.4 or later[/b].[/*]
[*][size=3]Download [b]Stardew Messages - Tutorial Pack[/b].[/size][/*]
[*]Extract the archive directly into your "[i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]" folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI.[/*]
[*]The tutorial starts automatically in game.[/*]
[/list]After installation, your [i]Mods [/i]folder should contain:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Stardew.Messages/
Stardew Valley/Mods/Stardew.Messages.Lessons/[/code]
If you install the French translation, extract it into the same [i]Mods [/i]folder and allow folder merging/overwriting when asked.

[size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]8 progressive narrative lessons[/b]
Learn the framework step by step through an in-game tutorial story, from your first message to advanced delivery flow.[/*]
[*][b]Learn by editing real files[/b]
Work directly with real JSON and i18n files, so the lessons can be reused as examples for your own content packs.[/*]
[*][b]Create SMS conversations[/b]
Understand how to build simple message threads, NPC messages, player replies, and conversation progression.[/*]
[*][b]Add choices and branching paths[/b]
Learn how to use [i]ChoiceId, NextStepId,[/i] and[i] StepId[/i] to create player choices and different outcomes.[/*]
[*][b]Create MMS content[/b]
Add MMS images, captions, thumbnails, tags, and Gallery entries using [i]AttachmentId [/i]and [i]mms_sets.json.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Create custom contacts[/b]
Build a new contact with a portrait, first messages, i18n text, and a proper contact definition.[/*]
[*][b]Use hidden senders and reveal scenes[/b]
Learn how to start a conversation with an unknown sender, then reveal the contact at the right moment.[/*]
[*][b]Delete threads, contacts, and traces[/b]
Understand how to cleanly remove a message thread, optionally remove a contact, and think about related traces.[/*]
[*][b]Understand triggers and conditions[/b]
Learn how conversations can depend on conditions such as flags, relationships, locations, quests, time, or daily luck.[/*]
[*][b]Control delivery flow with [/b][i][b]Cost[/b][/i]
See how message delivery can be paced so the player is not flooded with too many conversations at once.[/*]
[*][b]Chain conversations together[/b]
Use [i]StartNextConversation[/i] to create immediate reactions, crossed conversations, and scripted message sequences.[/*]
[*][b]English main pack, French translation available[/b]
The main pack includes English text and documentation. A separate French translation pack includes French i18n and French documentation.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Important note for editing files[/b][/size]
Some lessons ask you to edit files while the game is open.

When that happens, use this loop:

[list=1]
[*]Read the instruction in game.[/*]
[*]Edit the requested file.[/*]
[*]Close Stardew Valley without sleeping.[/*]
[*]Relaunch the game.[/*]
[*]Sleep one night in game.[/*]
[*]See the result the next morning.[/*]
[/list]Why?

Stardew Valley and SMAPI do not reload all JSON/i18n files while the game is already running.
Sleeping saves the day and advances the lesson, but the edited files are only reloaded after restarting the game.

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Messages - Core Framework 1.0.4 or later[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Languages[/b][/size]
Main file:
[list]
[*]English text[/*]
[*]English documentation[/*]
[/list]Optional file:
[list]
[*]French translation[/*]
[*]French documentation[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Recommended use[/size][/b]
Play the tutorial once as a guided learning pack.

Then open the files and use them as examples for your own Stardew Messages content packs.

[b][size=5]Final note[/size][/b]
Have fun, experiment, break things, fix them, and feel free to imagine whatever kind of SMS/MMS stories you want.

This pack is only a starting point.
What you create next is up to you :)
